On Wed, Mar 17, 2026 at 4:05 PM Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — can you confirm whether we have an updated Type II or a current bridge for Acme?

Hi all — quick status:

- The most recent full SOC 2 Type II report we have is for audit period 2024‑06‑01 through 2025‑05‑31 (PDF name: redwood_soc2_20240601-20250531.pdf). That report was issued in June 2025.
- We issued an administrative reissue (metadata correction only) on 2026‑01‑10 to fix an internal date typo; that does not extend the audit period.
- We prepared a bridge letter dated 2025‑12‑15 that extended attestation coverage through 2026‑02‑28; that bridge has now lapsed.

Options for Acme:
1) We can send the Type II + the 2025 bridge and clearly call out the expired bridge dates (fastest). Attachment: redwood_soc2_20240601-20250531.pdf, bridge-2025-12-15.pdf
2) We can generate a short, signed bridge letter dated today that extends coverage to 2026‑04‑30; legal will need 24‑48h to approve language.
3) We expect the next SOC 2 Type II audit to complete in Q2 2026 — projected report delivery mid‑April. We can provide a formal timeline and interim bridge once legal signs off.

Recommendation: give Acme the Type II + the previous bridge (option 1) immediately and offer to follow up with an updated bridge or the new report as soon as available. Connor — please confirm you'd like me to attach and send now. If Acme requires an official (non‑expired) artifact for immediate procurement sign‑off we should expedite option 2 (I can start the bridge draft now).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_soc2_20240601-20250531.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB); bridge-2025-12-15.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
